name: Wake Forest
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Wake Forest for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Franklinton Christmas Parade) through December 31 (Evening Holiday Walk at Joyner Park), with the Lighting of Wake Forest (December 4), the Downtown Holiday Open House (December 5) and the Rolesville Christmas Parade (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Wake Forest

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Wake Forest, including Rolesville and Franklinton
  • 6 free events, including the Lighting of Wake Forest, the Downtown Holiday Open House and the Rolesville and Franklinton Christmas Parades
  • Meet Santa: Pictures with Santa, Calls from Santa and the Rolesville Tree Lighting
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Franklinton Christmas Parade (December 3), the Lighting of Wake Forest (December 4), the Rolesville Christmas Parade (December 6) and the Rolesville Tree Lighting (December 7)
  • Lights: Evening Holiday Walk at Joyner Park
  • Season: December 3 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Wake Forest families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Raleigh, which covers the Raleigh Christmas Parade and the Pullen Park Holiday Express train ride.
